title: A Nonanuclear Dysprosium(III)–Copper(II) Complex Exhibiting Single-Molecule Magnet Behavior with Very Slow Zero-Field Relaxation

material_class.structural_family: nonanuclear Dy3Cu6 cluster with three {Cu2II L2} dimers about a Dy3(μ3-OH)6 core

synthesis.procedure: All chemicals and solvents were used as received; preparations were performed under aerobic conditions. Ligand LH2 (1,1,1-trifluoro-7-hydroxy-4-methyl-5-azahept-3-en-2-one) was obtained by condensation of ethanolamine with 1,1,1-trifluoro-2,4-pentanedione in methanol by a previously reported method. [Dy3Cu6] was obtained in a one-pot reaction: LH2 (0.2 g, 1.02 mmol) was dissolved in methanol (10 mL) and [Dy(ClO4)3]·6H2O (0.26 g, 0.56 mmol) in methanol (10 mL) was added dropwise with stirring over 10 min. A solution of CuCl2·2H2O (85 mg, 0.50 mmol) in methanol (5 mL) was added to the resulting clear yellow solution; the solution turned clear green and stirring was maintained for 5 min. Triethylamine (0.2 mL) was then added to give a deep-blue solution. One week of slow evaporation gave 125 mg of square-plate blue single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction, which were isolated by filtration and washed with a small amount of methanol (60% yield based on Cu).
synthesis.time: ligand/Dy mixing 10 min; after Cu addition stirred 5 min; crystallization by slow evaporation for 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot aerobic solution reaction; slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: slow evaporation for one week afforded square-plate blue single crystals; isolated by filtration and washed with a small amount of methanol

properties.summary: The Dy3Cu6 cluster is an SMM: χT = 43.56 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (close to 44.75 expected for 6 CuII + 3 DyIII), falling to 7.57 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K shows a two-step curve (~6–7 μB at 10 kOe, ~19 μB at 50 kOe). Single-crystal micro-SQUID data below 1.1 K show hysteresis of the first step with Hc = 15 kOe at 0.1 K. ac susceptibility is strongly frequency-dependent below 5 K; Arrhenius fit of relaxation gives Ueff = 25 K and τ0 = 1.5×10−7 s, with slow zero-field relaxation.

measurements.name: coercive field Hc
measurements.conditions: single crystal, micro-SQUID, 0.1 K, scan rate 0.002 T s−1; hysteresis of first magnetization step below 1.1 K

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of ac χ″ maxima (1.8–4 K) and dc magnetization decay (1.8–0.04 K) in the high-temperature regime

measurements.name: τ0
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit τ = τ0 exp(Ueff/kB T)
